description: This file defines functions for parsing JSON strings and converting them into CMake-compatible strings, including handling escape sequences and quotation marks.

methods.name: json_string_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a JSON-formatted string into a CMake string, handling escape sequences and quotes.

methods.name: json_string_ref_to_cmake
methods.description: Reference version that applies 'json_string_to_cmake' to the referenced JSON string.
